title: Agentic equation-discovery runtime and hyperreduced constitutive-model transfer
hypothesis: A persistent, typed scientific-evidence runtime plus structure-preserving reduced-order inverse material identification may reduce search/calibration cost while preserving physical constraints and full-order predictive quality.
mechanism: Use a shared evaluator and persistent candidate provenance for equation search; use adaptive POD/ECSW and adjoint sensitivities for inverse FE model updating, with full-order canaries and held-out material/load-path checks.
physical_units_and_constraints: energy and entropy constraints for GENERIC models
baseline: Matched full-order FE identification and existing equation_discovery.py workflow under pinned datasets, solver, objective, hardware, precision and resource budgets.
combined_output_contract: Same accepted equation/material prediction, same boundary conditions, same held-out specimens/load paths and same error tolerances.
expected_gain: Lower total inverse-model/search cost without loss of held-out prediction quality; not yet measured by UQPU.
negative_effects: full-order checks may dominate wall time
anisotropy and inelasticity are outside demonstrated source scope
external benchmark results do not transfer directly to Pangola
uncertainty: High: external preprints only; no source implementation reproduction, project data, coupon tests or independent replication.
falsifier: Reject if full-order checks erase total speed gain, held-out mesh/load-path errors exceed predeclared limits, localization causes unstable reduced predictions, or material parameters remain non-identifiable.
rollback: Keep the current full-order FE and equation-discovery paths as the reference; disable any reduced model that fails canary or held-out checks.
next_experiments: Pin and reproduce the first experimental case in arXiv:2610.31322 against full-order FE.
Measure bootstrap, canary, rebuild and final full-order costs separately.
Run localization negative control, independent mesh/solver and held-out deformation paths.
Compare persistent candidate/evidence state against equation_discovery.py with identical train/validation/test splits.
Qualify Pangola coupon material class before any transfer; reject isotropic-hyperelastic assumptions if measured behavior is anisotropic, viscoelastic or inelastic.
